fields.options:
Common labels to use as Match Label below - exact text varies a little by Frappe version, so treat this as a starting point and verify against what you actually see on screen.
User avatar menu (top right): My Settings · Toggle Theme · Toggle Full Width · Session Defaults · Reload · View Website · Log out
"?" help menu: About · Keyboard Shortcuts · Documentation · Report an Issue · User Forum · Frappe School · Frappe Support

fields.description: Turn this one rule off without deleting it.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Exact visible text of the menu/sidebar/dropdown item to target, as currently shown (e.g. "View Website", "My Settings").
fields.label: Match Label

fields.description: Hides the item entirely - the fields below are ignored when this is on.
fields.label: Hide This Item

fields.description: Leave blank to keep the current text.
fields.label: New Label

fields.description: A route (e.g. /app/sales-order) or full URL. Leave blank to keep the current link.
fields.label: New Link

fields.description: A built-in Frappe icon name (e.g. "globe") or an uploaded image's URL - best-effort, applied through whichever icon mechanism the matched element actually uses.
fields.label: New Icon
